title: The Last Tide
author: Odile Joubert
blurb: Jonah Eriksen, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
